mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version Numbering Scheme

The project's current recorded decision is to use semantic versioning (semver), in which the version number is structured as major.minor.patch: a major increment signals breaking changes, a minor increment signals backward-compatible features, and a patch increment signals backward-compatible fixes. The rationale on record is that encoding compatibility guarantees directly in the version number gives users managing dependencies and planning upgrades a clear signal of what to expect from each release.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md
